name: Remich in a day
description_md:
Remich in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city main sights. The route covers 5.0 km of walking between stops in Remich, LU.

The walk features 4 sightseeing stops. The day is anchored in Remich. The full day takes about 6.3 hours, which includes the visit time at each stop.
